question: Should this PR be allowed to merge with parser-only terminal proof, or should maintainers require live Claude CLI raw-stream plus WebChat/TUI evidence first?
rationale: The code path appears to be the right owner boundary, but the user-facing bug depends on a live external CLI stream shape and UI delivery path that the supplied proof does not exercise.

options.title: Require live stream proof
options.body: Ask for redacted live Claude CLI raw-stream plus WebChat or TUI evidence before merge so the dependency payload and user-visible delivery path are both proven.

options.title: Accept parser-only proof
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept the production-parser terminal exercise, while owning the remaining live-stream uncertainty.

options.title: Pause behind the linked issue
options.body: Keep this PR open until a branch can prove the current-main live path against the linked streaming regression.

recommendation.title: Require live stream proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted live Claude CLI raw-stream plus WebChat or TUI evidence before merge so the dependency payload and user-visible delivery path are both proven.
